text: ここは　１のしま　ごえんが　あつまる　むすびじま

structure.jp: ごえんが　あつまる　むすびじま
structure.en: the Knot Island where bonds gather

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ごえんが　あつまる　むすびじま
patterns.explanation: A short phrase ending in a verb, put right before a thing, describes that thing. ごえんが　あつまる　むすびじま = 'the Knot Island where bonds gather'.
